question: The term 'off break' is used in which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Cricket__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **off break** is a type of delivery in the sport of **cricket** and is the attacking delivery of an off-spin bowler.
 
• Off-break bowlers are known as off-spinners. 
 
• An off break is bowled by holding the cricket ball in the palm of the hand with the seam running across under all the fingers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Football is a family of team sports that involve, to varying degrees, kicking a ball to score a goal. 
 
• **Hockey** is a term used to denote various types of both summer and winter team sports which originated on either an outdoor field, sheet of ice, or dry floor such as in a gymnasium. 
 
• **Badminton** is a racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net. Although it may be played with larger teams, the most common forms of the game are "singles" and "doubles".
